about.title: Bell Gardens Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Bell Gardens is a compact, densely populated city, and its main corridors — Florence Avenue, Eastern Avenue, Gage Avenue, and Garfield Avenue — carry heavy local traffic throughout the week. Public records show 140 injury collisions and 185 people injured in the most recent reporting year, with crashes clustering on Friday afternoons between 4 and 6 p.m. as commuters, shoppers, and school traffic converge. After a wreck like this, the first hours and days matter: skid marks fade, surveillance footage gets overwritten, and witnesses move on. LawProactive is a free service that connects injured Bell Gardens residents with an independent personal injury attorney who can start gathering evidence and dealing with insurance adjusters while you focus on recovering. We're not a law firm ourselves — we simply make the introduction, and any attorney you work with only gets paid if you recover compensation.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer Calls

items.title: California's Fault Rules Can Work in Your Favor
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly responsible for the crash. An attorney can help make sure your share of fault isn't overstated by the other driver's insurer.

items.title: Deadlines Are Shorter Than You'd Think
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a car accident lawsuit in California, but if a government vehicle or road defect was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Missing it can end your claim before it starts.

items.title: What You Say Early Can Be Used Later
items.desc: Insurance adjusters often ask for a recorded statement soon after a crash, hoping to lock in language that limits your claim. An independent attorney can handle that communication so nothing you say is used against you.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover money. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward.

items.question: Was my crash on Gage Avenue or Florence Avenue serious enough to need a lawyer?
items.answer: If you sought medical treatment, missed work, or are dealing with an insurance company that's pushing back, it's worth a free conversation with an attorney. Corridors like Gage and Florence Avenue see a steady volume of injury collisions each year, and even claims that seem minor can involve complications you don't expect.

items.question: What if the other driver's insurance company already contacted me?
items.answer: It's common for insurers to reach out quickly after a crash, sometimes asking for a recorded statement. You're not obligated to give one, and it's generally safer to speak with an attorney first so your words aren't used to reduce your claim later.
